_origin: S35 Walk #4 reviewer #12: extracted from C10 v0.4 spec § 3 Phase 4 inline mapping table. Moves fixture-mapping out of code/spec text into versioned KB so v2/v3 luxury fixtures (bidet, dual-sink kitchens, modern utility) extend the KB without spec/code change.
_status: DRAFT — supports C10 v0.5 PROPOSED. Not LOCKED.
_lookup_key: (room_category, bathroom_subtype) where bathroom_subtype = null for non-bathroom rows
_fixture_types_must_exist_in: kb/plumbing_minimums.json — Inv 16 of C10 v0.5 enforces this consistency

rows._note: Standard Indian residential combined bathroom: WC + sink + shower stall.
Bath area without WC — typical in 3+ bath dwellings as washroom.
Standalone WC. NBC 2016 Part 3 Clause 12.4. Often the smallest wet room.
Single sink default. Dual-sink luxury extension via B-227.
Indian utility room: washing machine + utility sink. Fixture mapping covers sink only; washing-machine connection is separate plumbing concern (B-220).

_v2_extension_notes: Future fixtures via B-227: bidet (typically paired with WC in luxury bathrooms), dual_kitchen_sink, dishwasher_drain, washing_machine_drain, water_purifier_drain. Each new fixture must add a row to kb/plumbing_minimums.json first (trap_arm_max_m + pipe diameter + trap seal), then this profile KB references it.
